translation_notes: Only the removal is translated: `self.g.remove((s, p, o))` -> `@graph self.g` + `-{ {s} {p} {o} }`, fully bound (s, p, o come out of the loop's own triples, never None). The island is correct but buys almost nothing here: one line for one line, plus the `@graph` declaration.

The READ stays Python and is what makes the region awkward: `self.g.triples(trip)` where `trip` is a list built at run time with `find` in position i and None elsewhere, i in range(3). The pattern is DATA (its wildcard position is computed), and m{ } takes a written pattern. `ldpy.ANY` would stand for the wildcards, but a wildcard is never projected and the loop needs the three terms back (`rep = [s, p, o]; rep[i] = replace`). The only m{ } rendering is to unroll the loop into three (`m{ {find} ?p ?o }`, `m{ ?s {find} ?o }`, `m{ ?s ?p {find} }`), which duplicates the body and loses the 'replace in position i' structure: not done (no refactoring). Missing: a pattern whose wildcard position is a run-time value, projected.
`self.add_trip(*rep)` is the project's own helper (CURIE expansion, empty-object guard), not an rdflib call: it stays. Nothing here for `+{ }`.

Context shim pyontutils_context.py: makeGraph from pyontutils/core.py@cb3efcd10f, `expand`, `check_thing` and `add_trip` verbatim, `__init__` reduced to `g` and `namespaces`. pyontutils is not installed in the study venv (it also needs the ontology tool chain), so it is a shim and not the real package.
No `@prefix`: the region names no vocabulary term, so `@graph self.g` adds no prefix binding to the caller's graph.

Driver: 6 calls on the same fixture, each with a fresh graph: IRIs (all positions, triples with `find` two and three times that go through half-replaced states, neighbours ex:oldish and another namespace's `old`), CURIEs expanded by check_thing, no match, an empty-literal replacement (add_trip refuses the empty object, the removal still happens), a literal `find`, an unknown-prefix replacement (KeyError after partial work, compared as the outcome). Mutants killed: `-{ {s} {p} ?x }`, `-{ ?x {p} {o} }`, removal deleted.
